note: Independent re-audit against RFC 5176 Section 2.3 and working-tree TestRFC5176LengthFieldGovernsTheOctetsRead. Positive half appends 8 trailing zero octets past Length and asserts Disconnect-ACK plus teardowns == 1 (reading past Length fails auth and decode). Negative half now isolates pktLen > len(data): alongside the truncated copy, it sends a well-formed N-byte Disconnect-Request (fresh Identifier 2, complete TLVs, current Event-Timestamp, header Length set to N+4) with both Message-Authenticator and Request Authenticator computed over the N arrived octets, asserting silent discard and teardowns remaining 1. An implementation clamping pktLen to len(data) across VerifyCoARequestAuth, Decode and VerifyCoAMessageAuthenticator would accept and ACK the packet and increment teardowns.
